profile.headline: Software Engineer - React.js, Node.js, Python
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer with over seven years of experience, I specialize in leveraging technologies like React.js, TypeScript, and AWS to create impactful software solutions.

My expertise lies in end-to-end system design, including architecture decisions and the implementation of AI-driven solutions. Passionate about creating accessible and user-friendly applications, I collaborate with cross-functional teams to align product visions with technical strategies. My work is driven by a commitment to delivering high-performance, maintainable, and innovative systems that address real-world challenges.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered features for Benefit Karma at Trajector Medical, a public platform providing free tools to help disabled veterans navigate disability benefits. Led an AI automation initiative using AWS Strands Agents to streamline business operations.

► Drove end-to-end system design for greenfield application,  from requirements elicitation and feasibility analysis through architecture decisions,  selecting React, Next.js, and TypeScript to meet performance and maintainability goals.

► Engineered AI agents using Python and AWS Strands Agents to process and classify submitted documents, reducing processing time from hours to minutes and cutting costs by ~80%.

► Partnered with Product and Marketing teams to gather internal requirements and integrated Storyblok headless CMS, delivering self-service content tooling that empowered teams to independently publish and manage site pages without engineering involvement. 

► Modernized authentication infrastructure by implementing magic link and social login flows, reducing credential-based attack surface and hardening the platform against cybersecurity threats.
Mentored junior engineers on emerging tech stacks and stakeholder scoping practices, accelerating delivery of small, focused projects within tight timeframes.


Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, Tailwind CSS, Git, REST APIs, AWS Strands
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Git · Node.js · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed frontend features at Chronograph for a React/TypeScript application serving Limited Partner clients, working alongside a small engineering team with a Rails backend.

► Delivered new features consistently within a weekly release cadence, operating across a continuous deployment pipeline to maintain predictable, high-frequency shipping.

► Contributed to cross-functional roadmap planning alongside Design and Product, translating product vision into scoped, actionable initiatives for the engineering backlog.

► Modernized the SAAS product UI and contributed to the internal component library, prioritizing web accessibility standards (WCAG) and contemporary design patterns to enhance usability across all user segments.

► Systematically refactored React Class components to Functional components with Hooks, improving code consistency, reducing maintenance overhead, and establishing modern patterns for future development.

► Designed and implemented the UI layer for an AI-driven document analysis chatbot, translating complex financial data into actionable insights through intuitive conversation flows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and built scalable backend solutions in Node.js on AWS, delivering millions of tax forms to international customers with high reliability and performance within tax reporting deadlines.

► Built white-label tax and financial document generation using React PDF, delivering customizable, enterprise-grade solutions for corporate clients with complex compliance requirements.

► Designed a scalable, API-driven platform in Node.js on AWS leveraging Lambda and ECS, enabling custom client needs to be generalized into multi-tenant features—scaling document processing from 100K to 3M+ per cycle and eliminating engineering overhead from one-off implementations.

► Established robust unit testing practices that decreased regression incidents and streamlined troubleshooting, enabling faster iteration and higher code quality across the codebase.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to ClarityFirst, a public-facing application with a React/TypeScript frontend, C# ASP.NET API, and PostgreSQL backend.

positions.title: Technical Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of a search and analysis tool at ExxonMobil, built with Angular 8 and TypeScript.
 ► Built analytics dashboards leveraging Microsoft App Insights to track feature adoption and user engagement, enabling data-driven product decisions.
 ► Developed geospatial analysis features integrating enterprise data with ArcGIS, enabling users to visualize and analyze complex geological information.
 ► Integrated an internal geological data API to auto-summarize studies, accelerating researcher productivity when analyzing unfamiliar areas and reducing research time.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Helping professors with grading exams and programming labs.

Administering programming labs and helping new students learn fundamentals in Java and C++.
